captions.detailed: A slant-top casino cabinet featuring an angled screen panel, a button deck with a large red spin button, and a lockable front belly door. The main cabinet is black, while the screen assembly shows light blue and red accents. The front belly door is designed to hinge open on a vertical side axis, the red spin button on the control deck moves up and down prismatically, and a small dark volume knob near the screen rotates continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a slant-top casino slot machine with an angled screen panel, a button deck, and a lower belly door. Incorporate a revolute joint for the side-hinged belly door, a prismatic joint for the red spin button on the deck, and a continuous rotational joint for a volume knob near the screen.
captions.factory: Create the main cabinet body using a base Box and an angled top Box for the screen housing. Model the belly door as a separate Box with cylindrical hinge knuckles, attached to the frame via a revolute articulation. Form the control deck with a small cylindrical button sleeve and a red cylindrical button, configured with a prismatic joint. Add a small cylindrical volume knob below the screen with a continuous joint.
